Overview

Ulyanovsk is a city in Ulyanovsk Oblast with a population of 620,000. The birthplace of Vladimir Lenin, a Volga River city with a well-preserved historic center and a major aviation industry. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
